Orbotech LTD (ORBK) Holding Maintained by Callahan Advisors Llc; As Apple (AAPL) Share Price Declined, Grubman Wealth Management Has Boosted Its Stake
May 22, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Callahan Advisors Llc increased its stake in Orbotech Ltd (ORBK) by 12.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Callahan Advisors Llc bought 6,710 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.02% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 61,365 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.08 million, up from 54,655 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Callahan Advisors Llc who had been investing in Orbotech Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.55% or $0.96 during the last trading session, reaching $63.09. About 620,236 shares traded. Orbotech Ltd. (NASDAQ:ORBK) has risen 91.25% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 79.70% the S&P500.
Grubman Wealth Management increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 167.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grubman Wealth Management bought 3,598 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 5,740 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $971,000, up from 2,142 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grubman Wealth Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $922.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.71% or $1.32 during the last trading session, reaching $187.63. About 16.71 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Callahan Advisors Llc, which manages about $289.56 million and $503.73M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Fiserv Inc (NASDAQ:FISV) by 2,675 shares to 45,385 shares, valued at $5.95M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in J. P. Morgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) by 4,651 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 132,219 shares, and cut its stake in Cvs Health Corporation (NYSE:CVS).
